task_name: Client focus session model — FocusSessionProvider + SSE seams

strengths: All DELIVERABLE scenarios verified in implementation and tests (27 focused tests across FocusSessionContext and BoardContext.focusSeams)
Three SSE seams implemented with correct control flow: focus returns early, card falls through to scheduleRefresh, membership fans out before getRemovalRedirect
409 contract handled correctly: version_conflict adopts body (including null) without GET; session_active adopts and rethrows; invalid_transition uses generic actionError
userId and workspaceId filters on focus_session.updated SSE prevent cross-user/workspace session leakage
Parameterized runPatchAction/runPost runners follow rule-of-three; createSubscriberRegistry shared across all four subscriber registries
Focus API isolated to FocusSessionProvider; provider mounted inside BoardProvider in App.tsx
Two commits with required conventional messages; only the seven scoped files changed
Full client suite (786 tests) and typecheck pass at reviewed SHA

issues.description: useFocusSession() throws outside FocusSessionProvider (matching useBoard) but no unit test asserts the throw
Non-404 load failures are re-thrown inside a void promise chain, which may surface as an unhandled rejection rather than a user-visible load error (404 path is correctly silent)
